searches.stdout: frontier/iterations/i77-weighted-switch-mixing.md:24:* **Anari–Oveis Gharan–Rezaei, [1602.05242v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.05242v3):** the chain and Theorem 1.1 apply to homogeneous strongly Rayleigh measures and single-element exchanges on matroid bases. A weighted subset slice fits that support; general degree-constrained graph edges do not. For example, among the three perfect matchings of K4, deleting one edge and inserting one edge from another matching never preserves all degrees. The required basis-exchange property fails. We give a direct slice proof below rather than invoking a global spectral-independence theorem.
